# Route text blocks for app OpuromGallery (mobile-fix group)
# Deliver text only; Chief merges into apps/gallery/opurom_gallery.opu.
# quality { msaa: 4 } is declared at the single app root, not here.
#
# Global state keys used by these routes (declare ONCE at app level):
#   state navComments = true
#   state navCalendar = false
#   state navAccount = false
#   state themeSelection = "System"
#   state textScaling = "System"
#   state textDirection = "Based on locale"
#   state localeValue = "System - English (United States)"
#   state platformMechanics = "Android"
#   state slowMotion = false
#
# Navigation chain (push/pop):
#   Home -> Dialogs (SHOW DIALOG) -> DialogsAlert ; DialogsAlert CANCEL/DISCARD pop
#   Home -> Settings -> SettingsThemeOptions (Theme dropdown)
#   Home -> BottomNav -> BottomNavCalendar (Calendar tab)
#
# KERNEL GAP (DialogsAlert): the IR has no stacking/overlay primitive and
# `inset()` clamps margin to >= 0, so a 54% scrim cannot composite over the
# underlying route content, and the overlay cannot intercept clicks. The
# DialogsAlert route below delivers the expressible parts (centered white box,
# 4px corners, 24sp title, rose action buttons) over a flat #757575 base whose
# value is the measured 54% black-over-white composite. It is NOT a true scrim:
# the dimmed band/icons are absent and there is no click interception. A kernel
# scrim/overlay primitive is required to close this gap; no prop was invented.
#
# SECOND KERNEL GAP (DialogsAlert actions): a Button's text colour is owned by
# the palette/variant, never by its `color` prop (which paints the fill).
# `variant:"text"` forces PRIMARY blue; setting `color:"#B00020"` yields a rose
# filled pill with contrast text, not golden's flat rose label. Only Button
# accepts tap handlers, so flat rose text with pop cannot be expressed. The
# route uses rose-filled buttons; flat rose labels need kernel support.

# ---- BottomNav: rehosted verbatim from apps/gallery_bottom_navigation ----
  route BottomNav {
    Container(width: 1080, height: 2400, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
      Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
        // md-sys-color-surface; M3 top bar (deliberate deviation from golden gray/red bar)
        Container(width: 1080, height: 168, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
          Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
            Spacer(width: 48)
            Container(width: 72, height: 168, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
              Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
                Spacer(height: 48)
                // md-sys-color-on-surface
                Icon(name: "arrow-left", width: 72, height: 72, color: "#000000", label: "bottomnav/topbar_back")
              }
            }
            Spacer(width: 24)
            Container(width: 72, height: 168, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
              Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
                Spacer(height: 48)
                // md-sys-color-on-surface
                Icon(name: "info-circle", width: 72, height: 72, color: "#000000", label: "bottomnav/topbar_info")
              }
            }
            Spacer(width: 24)
            Container(width: 72, height: 168, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
              Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
                Spacer(height: 48)
                // md-sys-color-on-surface
                Icon(name: "code", width: 72, height: 72, color: "#000000", label: "bottomnav/topbar_code")
              }
            }
            Spacer(width: 24)
            Container(width: 72, height: 168, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
              Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
                Spacer(height: 48)
                // md-sys-color-on-surface
                Icon(name: "devices", width: 72, height: 72, color: "#000000", label: "bottomnav/topbar_devices")
              }
            }
            Spacer(width: 24)
            Container(width: 648, height: 168, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
              Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
                Spacer(height: 48)
                // md-sys-color-on-surface; title-large 66px w500
                Text("Bottom navigation", size: 66, fontPx: 66, weight: "bold", color: "#000000", label: "bottomnav/title")
              }
            }
          }
        }
        Spacer(height: 107)
        // md-sys-color-primary; demo content color, not the AppBar
        Container(width: 1080, height: 147, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
          Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
            Spacer(width: 42)
            Container(width: 993, height: 147, radius: 24, color: "#6200EE", border: "#6200EE", p: 0) {
              Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#6200EE", border: "#6200EE") {
                Spacer(height: 34)
                Spacer(width: 32)
                Text("Persistent labels", size: 66, fontPx: 66, weight: "bold", color: "#FFFFFF", label: "bottomnav/title_band")
              }
            }
          }
        }
        Spacer(height: 323)
        // photo/graphic asset, text-free; plus bubble is part of the graphic
        Container(width: 1080, height: 1011, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
          Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
            Spacer(width: 131)
            Image(src: "data:image/png;base64,", width: 820, height: 1011, fit: "fill", label: "bottomnav/graphic")
          }
        }
        Spacer(height: 329)
        // md-sys-color-surface; onNavSelected bound via navComments/... bool states.
        // onIndicatorMoved follows the active state; onDragUpdate/onDragEnd await A2/B3 gesture lerp.
        Container(width: 1080, height: 147, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
          Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
            // md-sys-color-surface; Comments nav item
            Container(width: 360, height: 147, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
              Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: center, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
                Spacer(height: 18)
                if (navComments) {
                  // md-sys-color-primary; selected icon
                  Icon(name: "bubble-plus", width: 48, height: 48, color: "#6200EE", label: "bottomnav/nav_comments_icon_on")
                } else {
                  // md-sys-color-on-surface-variant; unselected icon
                  Icon(name: "bubble-plus", width: 48, height: 48, color: "#000000", opacity: 0.6, label: "bottomnav/nav_comments_icon_off")
                }
                Spacer(height: 8)
                if (navComments) {
                  // md-sys-color-primary; native Button five-state press feedback
                  Button("Comments", width: 360, fontScale: 2.6, color: "#FFFFFF", variant: "text") {
                    navComments = true
                    navCalendar = false
                    navAccount = false
                  }
                } else {
                  // md-sys-color-on-surface-variant
                  Button("Comments", width: 360, fontScale: 2.6, color: "#FFFFFF", variant: "ghost") {
                    navComments = true
                    navCalendar = false
                    navAccount = false
                  }
                }
                if (navComments) {
                  // md-sys-color-primary; indicator width = label text width
                  Container(width: 240, height: 6, color: "#6200EE", border: "#6200EE", p: 0)
                } else {
                  Container(width: 240, height: 6, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0)
                }
              }
            }
            // md-sys-color-surface; Calendar nav item
            Container(width: 360, height: 147, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
              Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: center, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
                Spacer(height: 18)
                if (navCalendar) {
                  // md-sys-color-primary; selected icon
                  Icon(name: "calendar", width: 48, height: 48, color: "#6200EE", label: "bottomnav/nav_calendar_icon_on")
                } else {
                  // md-sys-color-on-surface-variant; unselected icon
                  Icon(name: "calendar", width: 48, height: 48, color: "#000000", opacity: 0.6, label: "bottomnav/nav_calendar_icon_off")
                }
                Spacer(height: 8)
                if (navCalendar) {
                  // md-sys-color-primary; native Button five-state press feedback
                  Button("Calendar", width: 360, fontScale: 2.6, color: "#FFFFFF", variant: "text") {
                    navComments = false
                    navCalendar = true
                    navAccount = false
                  }
                } else {
                  // md-sys-color-on-surface-variant
                  Button("Calendar", width: 360, fontScale: 2.6, color: "#FFFFFF", variant: "ghost") {
                    navComments = false
                    navCalendar = true
                    navAccount = false
                  }
                }
                if (navCalendar) {
                  // md-sys-color-primary; indicator width = label text width
                  Container(width: 240, height: 6, color: "#6200EE", border: "#6200EE", p: 0)
                } else {
                  Container(width: 240, height: 6, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0)
                }
              }
            }
            // md-sys-color-surface; Account nav item
            Container(width: 360, height: 147, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
              Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: center, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
                Spacer(height: 18)
                if (navAccount) {
                  // md-sys-color-primary; selected icon
                  Icon(name: "user-circle", width: 48, height: 48, color: "#6200EE", label: "bottomnav/nav_account_icon_on")
                } else {
                  // md-sys-color-on-surface-variant; unselected icon
                  Icon(name: "user-circle", width: 48, height: 48, color: "#000000", opacity: 0.6, label: "bottomnav/nav_account_icon_off")
                }
                Spacer(height: 8)
                if (navAccount) {
                  // md-sys-color-primary; native Button five-state press feedback
                  Button("Account", width: 360, fontScale: 2.6, color: "#FFFFFF", variant: "text") {
                    navComments = false
                    navCalendar = false
                    navAccount = true
                  }
                } else {
                  // md-sys-color-on-surface-variant
                  Button("Account", width: 360, fontScale: 2.6, color: "#FFFFFF", variant: "ghost") {
                    navComments = false
                    navCalendar = false
                    navAccount = true
                  }
                }
                if (navAccount) {
                  // md-sys-color-primary; indicator width = label text width
                  Container(width: 210, height: 6, color: "#6200EE", border: "#6200EE", p: 0)
                } else {
                  Container(width: 210, height: 6, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0)
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
        Spacer(height: 168)
      }
    }
  }

# ---- Other mobile-fix routes ----

  route DialogsAlert {
    Container(width: 1080, height: 2400, color: "#757575", border: "#757575", p: 0) {
      Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: center, color: "#757575", border: "#757575") {
        Spacer(height: 1034)
        Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: center, color: "#757575", border: "#757575") {
          Spacer(width: 174)
          Container(width: 732, height: 334, radius: 4, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF", p: 0) {
            Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
              Spacer(height: 60)
              Spacer(width: 66)
              Text("Discard draft?", size: 56, fontPx: 56, weight: "normal", color: "#414141", label: "dialogs/alert_title")
              Spacer(height: 120)
              Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: end, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
                Spacer(width: 150)
                Button("CANCEL", width: 250, fontScale: 2.6, color: "#B00020") {
                  pop
                }
                Spacer(width: 12)
                Button("DISCARD", width: 300, fontScale: 2.6, color: "#B00020") {
                  pop
                }
                Spacer(width: 20)
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

        Container(width: 900, height: 132, radius: 28, color: "#ECEFF1", border: "#ECEFF1", p: 24) {
          Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#ECEFF1", border: "#ECEFF1") {

            Text("{localeValue}", size: 36, fontPx: 36, weight: "normal", color: "#B00020", label: "theme/locale_value")
          }
        }
        Spacer(height: 24)
        Container(width: 900, height: 132, radius: 28, color: "#ECEFF1", border: "#ECEFF1", p: 24) {
          Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#ECEFF1", border: "#ECEFF1") {
            Text("Platform mechanics", size: 42, fontPx: 42, weight: "normal", color: "#202124", label: "theme/platform")
            Text("{platformMechanics}", size: 36, fontPx: 36, weight: "normal", color: "#B00020", label: "theme/platform_value")
          }
        }
        Spacer(height: 24)
        Container(width: 900, height: 132, radius: 28, color: "#CFD8DC", border: "#CFD8DC", p: 24) {
          Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: center, color: "#CFD8DC", border: "#CFD8DC") {

            Spacer(width: 620)
            Icon(name: "chevron-up", width: 48, height: 48, color: "#202124", label: "theme/theme_chevron")
          }
        }
        Spacer(height: 24)
        Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
          Spacer(width: 130)
          Container(width: 4, height: 372, color: "#CFD8DC", border: "#CFD8DC", p: 0) {
            Spacer(width: 0)
          }
          Spacer(width: 56)
          Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
            Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: center, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
              Container(width: 64, height: 64, p: 0) {

                Radio(bind: themeSelection, value: "System", color: "#B00020")

              }
              Spacer(width: 48)
              Text("System", size: 48, fontPx: 48, weight: "normal", color: "#202124", label: "theme/option_system")
            }
            Spacer(height: 40)
            Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: center, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
              Container(width: 64, height: 64, p: 0) {

                Radio(bind: themeSelection, value: "Dark", color: "#B00020")

              }
              Spacer(width: 48)
              Text("Dark", size: 48, fontPx: 48, weight: "normal", color: "#202124", label: "theme/option_dark")
            }
            Spacer(height: 40)
            Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: center, color: "#FFFFFF", border: "#FFFFFF") {
              Container(width: 64, height: 64, p: 0) {

                Radio(bind: themeSelection, value: "Light", color: "#B00020")

              }
              Spacer(width: 48)
              Text("Light", size: 48, fontPx: 48, weight: "normal", color: "#202124", label: "theme/option_light")
            }
          }
        }
        Spacer(height: 60)
        Container(width: 900, height: 132, radius: 28, color: "#ECEFF1", border: "#ECEFF1", p: 24) {
          Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: center, color: "#ECEFF1", border: "#ECEFF1") {
            Text("Slow motion", size: 42, fontPx: 42, weight: "normal", color: "#202124", label: "theme/slow_motion")
          }
        }
      }
    }
